intent: A used-up run quota pauses an evaluation batch instead of ending it.
observable_outcome: get-context batch lists the amended rule as reviewed, proven by its tests.

acceptance_criteria.statement: An evaluation batch waits when Run refuses a trial with a refusal Run says will pass on its own, including a run quota that could not be counted; pauses with the reason recorded when the refusal is one the owner can outwait or fix, a credit top-up or a used-up daily or windowed run quota; and stops with the reason recorded on any other refusal.
When starting a batch's next trial finds its target gone, the batch stops with reason target_gone and starts no further trial.
